descriptions.cxc_append_8020c43c: Append count bytes to the shared string at +0. Reuse its six-byte header only when refs is one and capacity covers old length plus count plus terminator; otherwise allocate, copy old bytes, decrement/release the old header, append bytes, update the 16-bit length and write a zero terminator. Header fields are observed unsigned 16-bit refs, length and capacity.
